subject.title: Export installed agents as grouped Claw packages

question: Should ordinary `claws export` require a complete, corroborated, exact installed state and reserve drifted/partial exports for a separately named snapshot mode with lineage and a drift report?
rationale: The branch can implement either policy, but choosing the default determines the safety and portability promise of a new core package-export surface; source-level review cannot safely infer that product commitment.

options.title: Fail closed by default
options.body: Require exact healthy state for ordinary export and design a later explicit snapshot mode for partial or drifted state.

options.title: Allow snapshots now
options.body: Permit drifted or partial export only with an explicit mode and require durable machine-readable drift and lineage output before landing.

recommendation.title: Fail closed by default
recommendation.body: Require exact healthy state for ordinary export and design a later explicit snapshot mode for partial or drifted state.

likelyOwner.reason: Their review comment identifies the decision boundary and the operational guarantees needed for a reproducible exported role.
